text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text:
It's hard to believe that this was just a 
qualifying round, but it was a great, 
heated race!

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text:
Next up is the semifinals, where you will 
face the others powerful enough to make it 
through. It will surely be an even tougher 
race.

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'm looking forward to your continued 
success!
